# SimpleBroker

> A lightweight message queue with a Unix CLI and matching Python client.
> Default install has no runtime dependencies; state is a local SQLite
> database (optional Postgres/Redis backends). No server, no daemon.

## Docs

- [Agent kernel (use vs embedding)](docs/agent-kernel.md): Canonical agent-facing kernel — CLI/`Queue` use surface, delivery hazards, safe reservation recipes, embedding notes for Weft/Taut-style runtimes
- [Product section registry](docs/specs/product-section-registry.md): Mechanical ownership state for product doc sections (`readme-only` / `draft-spec` / `canonical-spec`)
- [CLI spec](docs/specs/10-cli.md): Canonical CLI exit codes, streams, JSON shapes, and bound string forms `[SB-CLI-1]`–`[SB-CLI-5]`
- [Delivery spec](docs/specs/11-delivery.md): Canonical claim, watch, move-reservation, peek, and transactional-generator rules `[SB-DELIVERY-*]`
- [Broadcast spec](docs/specs/12-broadcast.md): Canonical target selection, creation, atomicity, CLI selector, and backend compatibility rules `[SB-BCAST-1]` through `[SB-BCAST-6]`
- [Message identity spec](docs/specs/13-message-identity.md): Canonical hybrid-ID representation, allocation, write-return, high-water/cache, exact-ID, and move-preservation rules `[SB-ID-1]` through `[SB-ID-5]`
- [Timestamp selection spec](docs/specs/14-timestamp-selection.md): Canonical id filters, late older ids, and watch progress `[SB-SELECT-1]`–`[SB-SELECT-4]`
- [Persistence I/O spec](docs/specs/15-persistence-io.md): Canonical dump/load format, selection filters, caller-owned load freshness, and claimed-row inspection `[SB-IO-1]`–`[SB-IO-5]`
- [Python library API spec](docs/specs/16-python-library-api.md): Canonical public package root, `ext`, command layer, targets, and library packaging `[SB-API-1]`–`[SB-API-12]`
- [Operations spec](docs/specs/17-ops.md): Canonical implicit queues, metadata, physical delete, rename, aliases, vacuum, and destructive backend target cleanup `[SB-OPS-1]`–`[SB-OPS-7]`
- [Specs index](docs/specs/00-specs-index.md): Process and product spec read order
- [Advanced Python API and embedding guide](docs/guides/python.md): How-to depth for delivery guarantees, generators, watchers, async, sidecar, reactor, embedding client pattern, and command layer
- [Configuration, scoping, and tuning guide](docs/guides/configuration.md): Full `BROKER_*` catalog, project scoping and discovery precedence, `.broker.toml`, security notes, tuning
- [Backends guide](docs/guides/backends.md): Postgres/Redis extensions, backend selection, benchmarking harness, backend-author notes
- [CONTRIBUTING](CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup, test harness, release procedure
- [README](README.md): Human product entry; command/env/API catalogs, examples, and restatements that link canonical `[SB-*]` specs
- [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md): Behavior deltas for published releases
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Entry point for agents working *in this repository* (process, plans, reviews)
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): Vulnerability reporting

- [Storage schema and claim lifecycle](docs/implementation/09-storage-schema-and-claim-lifecycle.md): SQLite schema, claim-based deletion rationale, phase-lock setup coordination
